problem_match: same original equations and coefficient domain
same exceptional strata and reconstruction predicates
same input/output and admissible experiment class

exact_algebra_counts.rational_operation: one exact addition/subtraction/multiplication/division after reduction to a specified expression DAG; division guarded
exact_algebra_counts.bit_cost: record numerator/denominator maximum bitlength and total serialized certificate bytes; rational-operation count alone is not bit complexity
exact_algebra_counts.symbolic_size: record DAG nodes, monomials and peak intermediate support under a specified representation
exact_algebra_counts.proof_cost: record literal registered statement scope, auxiliary lemmas, certificate size and independent kernel replay time; line count is secondary

execution.generation: timed separately from certificate replay, no search-time saving inferred from replay alone
execution.matched_runtime: same frozen inputs, Python/Lean/toolchain/environment and cache state; repeat measurements and report median/range
execution.counterfactual: no claim about how fast historical agents would have finished
execution.saving_credit: exact fewer operations/size is mathematical compression; measured runtime must meet matched execution conditions

baseline: preserve the earlier solved result and published proof; new method must reproduce answer and guards on held-out instance
